title: Boilers, Power Plant Operations & PSME Code
subject: PIPE-CNS

questions.q: The percent rating of a water-tube boiler is 200%, factor of evaporation is 1.10, and heating surface is $400\text{ ft}^2$. Determine the rate of evaporation, in kg/hr.

In a geothermal power plant, the mass flow rate of ground water is 4,000 kg/s and the quality after throttling is 20%. If the turbine power is 80 MW, what is the change in enthalpy of steam between the inlet and outlet of the turbine?

A boiler operates at 82% efficiency while the mass of steam generated is 490,200 kg in 6 hours. The enthalpy of steam is 3,187 kJ/kg and feedwater enthalpy is 604.83 kJ/kg, while the fuel used has a heating value of 32,567.85 kJ/kg. Find the mass of fuel needed per day in metric tons.
An 80 MW power plant has an average load of 34,500 kW and a load factor of 0.75. Find the reserve power over peak load power.
Which of the following is one of the main purposes of refractory in a boiler furnace?
options: Help preheat the air for the furnace

questions.q: A 145,000-kW turbo-generator requires 690,000 kg/hr of steam at rated load and 23,000 kg/hr of steam at zero load. Determine the steam rate, in kg/kW-hr, at 75% of its rated load.
Why is a boiler feed tank heated to approximately $85°\text{C}$?
options: To reduce the energy required to raise steam
To reduce the content of total dissolved solids in the water supplied to the boiler
To reduce the gas content of the water
To reduce the content of suspended solids in the water
questions.answer: To reduce the gas content of the water

questions.q: What causes water hammer in the boiler?
options: Slugs of water in the steam
questions.answer: Slugs of water in the steam

questions.q: How does air enter a steam system?
options: Through joints on shut-down of the steam system
With make-up water to the boiler feedtank
With condensate entering the boiler feedtank

questions.q: Why should strainers installed on steam lines be fitted on their sides?
options: To prevent the build-up of water in the strainer body
To reduce the frequency of cleaning
To provide maximum screening area for the steam
questions.answer: To prevent the build-up of water in the strainer body

questions.q: A boiler installed where the atmospheric pressure is 752 mm Hg has a gage pressure of $12\text{ kg/cm}^2$. Find the absolute pressure, in kPaa.
What is the advantage of a pressurized deaerator over an atmospheric deaerator?
options: A boiler feed tank is no longer required
Less overall energy will be required to produce the steam
It can be fitted at ground level

questions.q: Assume that you are checking the water level in a boiler which is on the line in a power plant. Upon opening the gage cocks, you determine that the water level was above the top gage cock. Of the following actions, the best one to take first in this situation would be to:
options: Shut off the fuel and air supply
Close the steam outlet valve from the boiler
Increase the speed of the feedwater
questions.answer: Close the steam outlet valve from the boiler

questions.q: As used in the Revised PSME Code for Boilers and Pressure Vessels, it is any boiler which does not exceed any of the following limits: 405 mm inside diameter, 1,065 mm overall length of outside-to-outside heads at center, $1.85\text{ m}^2$ of water heating surface, and $7.03\text{ kg/cm}^2$ maximum allowable working pressure. What is this boiler?
It is a closed vessel in which steam or other vapor (to be used externally to itself) is generated by the direct application of heat used for power generation. How do you call this boiler?
It is a closed vessel intended for use in heating water or for application of heat to generate steam or other vapor to be used externally from it. What do you call this pressure vessel?
What do you call a vessel in which pressure is obtained from external sources, or from an indirect application of heat?
It is any boiler or unfired pressure vessel constructed, installed, and placed in operation, subject to annual inspection. What do you call this?
It is a boiler that has been inspected and declared unsafe to operate or disqualified, stamped and marked indicating its rejection. How do you call this boiler?
When new boilers are installed in either existing or new buildings, a minimum height of at least _________ shall be provided between the top of the boiler proper and the ceiling.
For power boilers, when the tensile strength of steel is not known, it shall be taken as 379 MPa and which of the following for wrought iron?
Name the principal cause of waterhammer:
options: Water allowed to build up in pipes
Water droplets carried along the insides of pipes
Wet steam passing through steam traps
questions.answer: Water allowed to build up in pipes

questions.q: What do you call a boiler of which both the location and ownership have been changed after primary use?
It is a boiler removed from its original setting and re-erected at the same location or erected at a location without change of ownership. How do you call this boiler?
Each miniature boiler shall be equipped with which of the following for the determination of water level?
The maximum allowable working pressure of a non-code steel or wrought iron heating boiler of welded construction shall not exceed which of the following pressures?
What do you call the method used to evaluate all welds performed on pressure parts of boiler tube materials?
It is a boiler testing method used to verify the microstructure of boiler tubes using optical microscopes. How do you call this method?
Generally, steam turbines in power stations operate at which of the following speeds?
Tidal power is the power generated from which of the following?
Upon entering the boiler room, you find the water out of the glass, the safety valve blowing off strongly, and a fire under the boiler. Your first action would be to:
options: Remove the fire with draft and damper open
Prevent priming by not raising the safety valve or making changes in operating engines or boiler
Cool the boiler down completely and prevent priming by not raising the safety valve
questions.answer: Remove the fire with draft and damper open

questions.q: The ASME Boiler Code for boiler shells requires a tensile strength of which of the following, in psi?
The best time to blow a boiler down is:
options: Once a day when the load is lightest
Once a day under full load
When the chemical concentration is greatest
questions.answer: When the chemical concentration is greatest

questions.q: In performing a hydrostatic test on an existing power boiler, the required test pressure must be controlled so that it is not exceeded by more than:
One of the two types of non-material nuclear radiation is:
Which of the following is NOT a qualification for an applicant for the ME board examination?
A thermohydraulic feedwater regulator is used to regulate the flow of water to a drum-type boiler. The amount of water input to the boiler is controlled in proportion to the:
options: Setting of the feed pump relief valve
Amount of water in the outer tube that flashes into steam

questions.q: Economical partial-load operation of steam turbines is obtained by minimizing throttling losses. This is accomplished by:
options: Reducing the boiler pressure and temperature
Throttling the steam flow into the uncontrolled set of nozzles
Dividing the first-stage nozzles into several groups and providing a steam control valve for each group
Controlling the fuel flow to the steam generator
questions.answer: Dividing the first-stage nozzles into several groups and providing a steam control valve for each group

questions.q: The main advantage of operating a steam engine or steam turbine "condensing" is that it:
options: Increases the mean effective pressure in the prime mover
Permits the use of exhaust steam to drive auxiliary equipment
Eliminates the need for separating non-condensables from the steam
questions.answer: Increases the mean effective pressure in the prime mover

questions.q: The automatic shut-off valves for a water gage installed on a high-pressure boiler must be:
The efficiency of a riveted joint is defined as the ratio of the:
options: Plate thickness to the rivet diameter
Strength of the riveted joint to the strength of a welded joint
Strength of the riveted joint to the strength of the solid plate
Number of rivets in the first row of the joint to the total number of rivets on one side of the joint
questions.answer: Strength of the riveted joint to the strength of the solid plate

questions.q: What is the advantage of an internal water level control over an external one?
options: The external control is in a 'dead' area
It is less likely to scale up
It will respond more quickly to changes in water level
Daily testing of the level control chamber is not required
questions.answer: Daily testing of the level control chamber is not required

questions.q: What is the purpose of testing gauge glasses?
options: To ensure the gauge cocks are operative
To ensure there is sufficient water over the top fire tube
To ensure the boiler water level is being properly sensed
To check the boiler 1st and 2nd low water level alarms
questions.answer: To ensure the gauge cocks are operative

questions.q: What is the effect of an overloaded boiler?
options: Water level rises and lock-out occurs
Water level drops and lock-out occurs
Steam velocity reduces and separator efficiency drops
questions.answer: Water level drops and lock-out occurs

questions.q: Why is slow, controlled warm-up of a steam system essential?
options: To make it easier to open the boiler main stop valve
To minimize undue stresses and eliminate damage
To permit separators to remove more water
To prevent stress on the boiler
questions.answer: To minimize undue stresses and eliminate damage

questions.q: Which of the following is the main purpose of the steam distribution manifold?
options: It replaces the need for a separator after the boiler
To remove air from the steam system
To provide an extra separating function
It is a requirement of the pressure systems regulations
questions.answer: To provide an extra separating function

questions.q: Priming of a boiler is:
options: Getting a boiler prepared for start-up
A reduction in boiler pressure and carryover of water
Occurrence of excessive TDS and carryover of water
Balancing of boilers in a multi-boiler installation
questions.answer: Occurrence of excessive TDS and carryover of water

questions.q: What is the advantage of an interruptible tariff?
options: Quick and easy to change to heavy fuel oil when required
Price of interruptible gas is lower than fixed supply
questions.answer: Price of interruptible gas is lower than fixed supply

questions.q: At what pressure should a boiler safety valve be set?
What is the purpose of a bottom blowdown valve?
How often, as a minimum, should gauge glasses be tested?
Why are two gauge glasses often fitted?
options: One is a check against the other

questions.q: What does MAWP stand for?
The bottom blowdown on a boiler is used to:
options: Reduce steam pressure in the header
